description: This file contains functions related to platform image verification and upgrade procedures for a device running OpenWrt, including partition handling, boot sector extraction, and device updates.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the partition layout of an image against the current device to determine if a full update is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the mounted partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the device upgrade process, including partition comparison, copying image data, and updating bootloader.
